turns.text: I think those herbs might be better if we, well, check them for mold first.

turns.text: I'll check them, I promise, they look super fresh and everything!

turns.text: Pip, do not just sit there. Help Tuk with this fur.

turns.text: Okay so I'm coming, I'm totally coming, I just needed a second to breathe...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Then sit and be still. The muffalo will not wait for your breath.

turns.text: I'm helping, see, I'm grabbing the brush and everything!

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Loosen your grip on the rifle. Four misses in a row means you are fighting the weapon.

turns.text: Okay so I'm totally trying, it's just like, the handle is really heavy and my hands keep slipping...

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Loosen your grip. It is the weight of the recoil, not the handle.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: The recoil? Like, it totally feels like the whole thing is trying to jump out of my hands!

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: Hm. Back's gone bad again. Don't just stare, Pip.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so, like, you totally need to sit down before you fall down...

turns.speaker: rook
turns.text: I'm fine, just need a minute to breathe.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: You're totally not fine, your face is like, super pale.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: Okay so I totally just sliced my hand on the wire, like, it really hurts...

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: Hold the hand still, Pip, or the blood will keep running.

turns.speaker: pip
turns.text: It's totally fine, it's just a little scratch, I promise!

turns.speaker: tuk
turns.text: It is not a scratch, it is a deep cut.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think, well, maybe the stitching is deep enough, but it's probably still seeping a bit.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: Negative. Do not worry about the blood. Just finish the stitching.

turns.speaker: moth
turns.text: I think... well, you really should take the medicine, if it's not too much trouble.

turns.speaker: ash
turns.text: I do not need the medicine. Just finish the job.
